info.name: Google Drive Volumes
info.summary: Mount Google Drive subdirectories as independent external disks under a common Nextcloud folder
info.description:
Mount multiple Google Drive subdirectories (e.g., NextCloud/Volume_1, NextCloud/Volume_2) as independent external virtual disks inside Nextcloud under a configurable common directory and subdirectory (e.g., Gdrive/Volume_1, Gdrive/Volume_2).
Features: - Single Google Drive account binding (OAuth 2.0 or Service Account JSON) per admin or personal scope - Multiple independent volume mappings from remote subdirectories or Folder IDs - Configurable common parent folder + subdirectory per disk (e.g., Gdrive/Volume_1) - Interactive Google Drive folder browser and optional auto-creation of remote folders - Per-volume read-only mode, independent virtual disk quota, and Google Docs export format - Metadata/path cache with configurable TTL, resumable chunked uploads, and OCC commands
info.author: krofinski
